items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: You remind me of the Turrentine brothers, and Erroll Garner

ctx.x: Must be something there too. Must be in the coal mines or something.

Pittsburgh turned out – people usually think of Philadelphia and Detroit, but Pittsburgh turned out quite a few. You remind me of the Turrentine brothers, and Erroll Garner, and you had mentioned . . .
